name: Agadir
title: Holidays in Agadir
intro: Morocco's sunniest beach resort, with a ten-kilometre sandy bay, a hilltop kasbah and winter warmth just four hours from the UK. Here's what Agadir is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: Agadir's long sandy bay and port seen from the kasbah hill

facts.label: Time difference
facts.value: 0 to 1 hr ahead of the UK

facts_note: Dirhams can only be bought in Morocco. Check entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: Agadir is sunny nearly all year, and the sea breeze keeps summer comfortable at around 27°C. It's best known for winter sun, with days around 20 to 23°C from November to March. The Atlantic stays cool, around 18 to 22°C.

things.name: Agadir beach
things.blurb: A long, wide sweep of sand with a palm-lined promenade.

things.name: Kasbah Oufella
things.blurb: The hilltop ruins above town, with views over the bay at sunset. Ride the cable car up.

things.name: Souk El Had
things.blurb: A huge walled market of spices, produce and crafts.

things.name: Taghazout
things.blurb: A surf village up the coast, with beginner waves and cafés.

things.name: Paradise Valley
things.blurb: Palm-lined rock pools in a gorge in the Atlas foothills.

things.name: Souss-Massa National Park
things.blurb: Dunes and wetlands where rare bald ibis live.

faqs.question: Is Agadir warm in winter?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's one of the warmest places within 4 hours of the UK, at around 20 to 23°C, though evenings are cool.

faqs.question: Is Agadir good for a beach holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. The beach is long and sandy with lifeguards, though the Atlantic can be wavy and cool.

faqs.question: Can you visit Marrakech from Agadir?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's about 3 hours by road, so it's better with an overnight stay.

faqs.question: How long is the flight to Agadir?
faqs.answer: About 3.5 to 4 hours from the UK.
